prompt_text:
Continue the given text:
Your entire life, you've been told you're deathly allergic to bees. You've always had people protecting you from them, be it your mother or a hired hand. Today, one slips through and lands on your shoulder. You hear a tiny voice say "Your Majesty, what are your orders?" 

You look around and see a small army of bees, all of them waiting for your command. You don't understand how you are even in this situation. You're allergic to bees. Why are they all waiting for your command? You look down at your arm and see a small bee stinger sticking out of your skin. You look down and are shocked. You were obviously stung but didn't have an allergic reaction.

You think to yourself, "what is going on?" The bee who called you Your Majesty ended up stinging you. He was marking you to be the Leader of the bee army.
reference_text:
You talk to that bee and ask him why he stung you. The bee tells you they need a leader that has access to a GPS.

The bee tells you that there is a garden that the bees need to get to in order to save their friends but they have no way of finding the place.

instruction.label: exactly once
instruction.rule: At least one tracked phrase ('garden', 'access', 'finding', 'place', 'save', 'talk', 'friends', 'order', 'ask', 'tells', 'need', 'way', 'get', 'leader', 'bees') must occur exactly once.
